segments.an3.114:1.3: Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ, kataññū katavedī puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an3.114:1.4: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tiṇṇaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmi”nti.

lines: Dutiye kataññū katavedīti “iminā mayhaṃ kata”nti tena katakammaṃ ñatvā viditaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā paṭikaraṇakapuggalo. 3.
Dutiye parena katassa upakārassa anurūpappavatti attani kataṃ upakāraṃ upakārato jānanto vediyanto kataññū katavedīti āha “iminā mayhaṃ kata”ntiādi.
